title: Excessive bluetooth pairing requests Pixel 5, latest build
body:
Been using XDrip for a while, upgraded phone and had no issues, but with my latest transmitter (changed about 7 days ago) I've got non-stop bluetooth pairing requests (might be from an Android Security patch that was recently installed too).  

Device: G6
App Version `7154791-2020.11.15`
G6 Firmware: `2.18.2.98`
Other Version: `0.48.69`
Transmitter is a 8L transmitter
The most frequent error message I see in the logs is talking about needing "BLUETOOTH_PRIVILEGED".  I've tried disabling OB1 unbonding, but then it just never connects. I have Android 10 setting flipped on. See messages like "Pairing failed so removing pairing automation"
Also see:
```
Could not read reply to auth challenge: 
com.polidea.rxandroidble2.exceptions.BleGattCannotStartException: 
GATT exception from MAC address [REDACTED], with type 
BleGattOperation(description='CHARACTERISTIC_READ')
```

comments.body:
I've experienced the same issue with my Pixel 5. It worked fine for 7 days, and then I started getting BT pairing requests every few minutes.

I wasn't able to find a proper solution; however, uninstalling xdrip and installing the latest nightly build resolved the issue. That was 6 days ago, and I'm anticipating the BT pairing requests returning in the next 24 hours or so

I also have the problem since today. I have a Samsung S9+ with a Dexcom D6 GSM. After today's Samsung update I get every 5 minutes the Bluetooth connection question. If I answer it with ok I can see the values.

Man, the reinstall would be easier if it preserved my alerts in the settings, but we'll see if this works or not.  My PREVIOUS sensor was also bad after 6 days, so I thought that could be the problem.  I'll keep tracking this, but I'll be sure to bring some extra supplies for my week-long trip.
